blacklistabilityReview.evidence: CUMIU is a single Ethereum deployment at 0x85d38585c3ac08268f598282a84b7c0ddfc0d04f (UUPS implementation 0x37686928ddf77be20fc4199f03f0638d90d9907e), holding 100% of measured supply. At Ethereum block 26224780, EOA 0x407374be435ed278fca44be695d32f0230fe46e3 returned true for DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, ENFORCER_ROLE and PAUSER_ROLE; paused() was false. The verified implementation exposes freeze(address,string)/unfreeze(address) under ENFORCER_ROLE and pause/unpause under PAUSER_ROLE, and validateTransfer routes through a rule engine, so the enforcer can freeze an individual holder and the pauser can halt all transfers. The legal KFS forbids peer-to-peer trading and permits record correction. Direct holder freeze on the only material deployment sets Yes.
